Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. VAGA REMOTA

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
About the Role

We’re looking for a highly organized, data-driven, and creative Marketing Operations Analyst to own the planning, execution, and optimization of multi-channel marketing initiatives of Bybit in Brazil. You will play a key role in scaling marketing operations, being responsible for growing, activating and retaining the Brazilian userbase delivering measurable results across marketing campaigns.

Key Responsibilities

  • Campaign Management: Plan, design, set up, and execute multi-channel marketing campaigns from concept to delivery.
  • Results and activation driven : creating campaigns that generate signups, first deposits and first trades in the app.
  • Process Optimization: Continuously iterate, improve, and build scalable marketing workflows and operational frameworks.
  • Channel Ownership: Manage and optimize performance across multiple channels — Email Marketing, Push Notifications, Landing Pages, Social Media, Affiliates, SEO, Paid Ads, and more.
  • Stakeholder Coordination: Collaborate closely with designers, translators, copywriters, operators, and developers to ensure timely and high-quality campaign delivery.
  • Planning & Budgeting: Lead quarterly planning for regional deliverables and team budgets; ensure efficient budget control and ROI optimization.
  • Testing & Optimization: Coordinate and analyze A/B tests across strategies, cohorts, and channels to enhance conversion rates and campaign effectiveness.
  • Data & Insights: Deliver actionable insights and analyses focused on acquisition, activation, and retention strategies.
  • Localization Quality: Oversee and improve translation quality for localized content (e.g., pt-BR) across app, website, and marketing assets.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in Marketing Operations, Growth, Digital Marketing, or related roles.
  • Strong analytical mindset with proficiency in marketing analytics tools (e.g., Excel, Google Analytics, Looker Studio, Tableau.)
  • Hands-on experience managing multi-channel marketing campaigns.
  • Excellent communication skills both in english and Brazilian Portuguese
  • Project management skills.
  • Familiarity with A/B testing, automation platforms, and performance measurement.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities.
  • Experience in crypto and/or fintechs is a plus
  • Bonus: Experience managing marketing efforts across multiple regions.

title: Affiliate Administrator – LATAM (Remote)
description:
Ready to take your affiliate marketing expertise to the next level? Join GrowthAssistant as an Affiliate Administrator and play a pivotal role in leading the entire affiliate marketing process for a top U.S.-based agency. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a renowned brand while driving performance, managing partner communications, and ensuring campaigns run smoothly from start to finish.


You’ll be at the heart of strategic marketing efforts with a focus on accuracy, trend analysis, and client success—all while enjoying the flexibility of a remote setup, competitive pay, and great benefits.


Compensation & Perks

  • Salary Range: $6.00 – $7.50/hour (Final offer based on skills and experience matched to role requirements)
  • 100% permanent work-from-home
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) for Vacation and U.S. Holidays
  • $300 Referral Bonus for every successful candidate you refer
  • Performance-Based Bonuses
  • Year-End Bonus (client-initiated)
  • Perfect Attendance Bonus (for LATAM candidates)


What You’ll Do

  • Performance Reporting: Download and prepare performance reports using proprietary analytics tools for End of Week (EOW), End of Month (EOM), and End of Year (EOY) deliverables
  • Compliance Monitoring: Conduct weekly checks of affiliate sites for valid/invalid promotion codes and send templated emails to partners in violation
  • Outreach for Corrections: Send outbound templated emails to partners requesting corrections for compliance violations
  • BrandVerity Checks: Perform semi-weekly checks to monitor for trademark infringements and follow up with violators

  • 2+ years of experience in affiliate marketing
  • Familiarity with Commission Junction or similar affiliate tools, and BrandVerity or similar platforms
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Intermediate proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and MS Office
  • Experience managing multiple clients or brands (a plus)
  • Highly organized, proactive, resourceful, and detail-oriented
  • Ability to work in any U.S. timezone or a night shift schedule in the Philippines


Why You’ll Love Working Here

At GrowthAssistant, you’ll collaborate with a diverse, talented team, sharpen your skills with global clients, and make an impact in affiliate marketing. We value your growth and recognize your contributions every step of the way.


Apply today and take the next step in your career with GrowthAssistant!

title: Coordenador de Arquitetura de Sistemas
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!


Principais atividades:

Coordenar equipe de arquitetos de software.

Avaliar a arquitetura atual, identificar necessidades de integração e projetar novas soluções.

Desenvolver modelos de arquitetura: Criar diagramas e documentação para descrever como os sistemas se interconectam e como a solução será implementada.

Escolher tecnologias: Selecionar as ferramentas e tecnologias adequadas para a integração, considerando fatores como desempenho, segurança e escalabilidade.

Implementar e testar soluções: Participar da implementação das soluções de integração e garantir que elas funcionem corretamente e de forma segura.

Manter e otimizar a integração: Monitorar o desempenho das integrações, identificar gargalos e implementar melhorias.

Documentar a arquitetura de integração: Criar documentação detalhada sobre a arquitetura, os padrões e as políticas de software.

Colaborar com outras áreas: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com outras equipes, como desenvolvimento de software, infraestrutura e segurança da informação, para garantir entrega eficiente da solução.

Manter-se atualizado: Acompanhar as tendências e tecnologias de integração, buscando soluções e abordagens mais eficazes.


Buscamos alguém que apresente :

Ensino superior completo nas áreas de Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas relacionadas.

Experiência de trabalho comprovada como Arquiteto de Soluções ou função similar.

Experiência em desenvolvimento de software e arquitetura de sistemas.

Inglês intermediário ou fluente.

Conhecimentos em arquitetura de software: Capacidade de compreender e projetar sistemas complexos.

Conhecimento de arquitetura em nuvem: usando Kubernetes e Openshift para eficiência e escalabilidade dos serviços.

Conhecimentos em segurança: Capacidade de projetar e implementar soluções de integração que sejam seguras e protegidas.

Conhecimento técnico: Sólidos conhecimentos em várias linguagens de programação, sistemas operacionais e bancos de dados.

Conhecimento de tecnologias de integração: Familiaridade com ferramentas e tecnologias de integração, como plataformas de integração de aplicativos (APIs), plataformas de integração de eventos (ESBs) como Kafka e RabbitMQ e de ferramentas de ETL.

Habilidades de liderança: Capacidade de liderar equipes e projetos, garantindo a implementação bem-sucedida da solução.


Competências comportamentais:


Adaptação à mudanças;

Habilidade para reconhecer problemas e propor soluções;

Entendimento e capacidade de ajustar às prioridades e direcionamentos;

Capacidade de assumir responsabilidades;

Trabalho em equipe:

Proatividade;

Comprometimento com as entregas;

Capacidade analítica e visão sistêmica;



Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.

Modelo de Trabalho: 100% Home Office

Carga Horária: 220h

description:

Texonica Alliance is seeking a Paid Social Executive to join our growing performance team — a role designed for marketers who blend analytical precision with creative flair.

You’ll be responsible for executing and optimizing paid social campaigns that drive growth for fashion, lifestyle, and e-commerce brands across global markets. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with a world-class creative team and make a measurable impact through data-driven storytelling.

What the Role Entails

You will manage campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and other key platforms from setup to analysis.

Your role includes audience research, creative testing, and campaign optimization to achieve performance goals.

You’ll monitor data, identify insights, and adjust strategies to improve ROI and engagement.

Collaboration with creative and marketing teams will be essential to align visuals, copy, and targeting with campaign objectives.

You’ll stay up to date with platform changes, advertising trends, and emerging digital tools.

Who Texonica Alliance Is Looking For

You are a performance marketer with one to three years of experience managing paid social campaigns.

You have hands-on expertise in Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads, and analytics tools.

A strong understanding of audience segmentation, ad testing, and conversion tracking is essential.

You balance analytical thinking with creativity, thrive in a collaborative setting, and bring a proactive mindset to every project.

Job Snapshot

Title: Paid Social Executive

Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote (Flexible Hours)

Schedule: 35–40 hours per week

Start Date: Immediate

Compensation: Competitive salary, based on experience

About Texonica Alliance

Texonica Alliance is a creative marketing studio where performance meets imagination.

We help global brands grow through campaigns that fuse storytelling, data, and strategy.

title: Pessoa Especialista em Segurança da Informação
description:
Sobre a vaga:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

  • Monitorar e analisar eventos de segurança em tempo real, utilizando ferramentas de SIEM (ex: Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar).
  • Responder a incidentes de segurança (IR) com base em playbooks e procedimentos padronizados.
  • Realizar investigações forenses e análise de comportamento de ameaças (UEBA).
  • Criar e manter alertas inteligentes, regras de correlação e casos de uso de segurança.
  • Trabalhar junto ao time de DevSecOps e Engenharia de Segurança para melhorar continuamente os controles e a detecção.
  • Documentar incidentes, elaborar postmortems de segurança, e realizar melhorias preventivas.
  • Apoiar simulações de ataque e resposta a incidentes (ex: tabletop exercises).
  • Produzir relatórios de inteligência e manter o time atualizado sobre táticas, técnicas e procedimentos (TTPs) utilizadas por agentes de ameaça.
  • Avaliar continuamente a eficácia das ferramentas de SOC e propor ajustes técnicos.
  • Garantir aderência às normas de compliance e governança, como ISO 27001, NIST e LGPD.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • SIEMs: Splunk, Azure Sentinel, QRadar, Elastic SIEM ou similares.
  • Ferramentas de EDR/XDR: CrowdStrike, Defender ATP, SentinelOne, Carbon Black.
  • Ferramentas de Threat Intel: MISP, VirusTotal, OpenCTI.
  • Protocolos de rede e logs: Syslog, NetFlow, PCAP, HTTP, DNS, LDAP, etc.
  • Experiência com automação e resposta com SOAR (ex: Phantom, Demisto).
  • Familiaridade com MITRE ATT&CK e uso de frameworks de cibersegurança. Conhecimentos básicos de scripts: Python, Bash ou PowerShell (desejável).
  • Certificações como CompTIA Security+, CEH, GCIA, GCFA ou equivalente são diferenciais.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Talent Development Partner
description:
About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at


Position Overview

We are seeking a highly creative and hands-on Senior Talent Development Partner to support the establishment of our newly formed Talent Development function. In this role, you will embrace a customer-centric, pragmatic approach, laser-focused on delivering maximum impact through the simplest, highest-quality solutions.

We are here for the growth and development of our customers, Turing Team Members. You will partner closely with leaders to understand their desired development outcomes, time constraints, and needs. Leveraging this knowledge, you will craft relevant, engaging learning content that drives measurable business results for our internal customers. You will seek out simple yet impactful solutions, recognizing that the most compelling learning experiences are often the most practical.


Responsibilities

  • Deeply collaborate with Turing leaders to translate team development needs into compelling, practical learning experiences driving measurable growth.
  • Design and develop engaging, multimedia-rich asynchronous learning content using tools like Articulate, tailoring for diverse styles through simple, high-impact solutions.
  • Serve as the go-to operational owner for the LMS system, curating and maintaining a dynamic, streamlined training catalog. Continuously refine materials for relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with customer needs.
  • Embody an agile, customer-obsessed mindset, rapidly producing high-quality, iterative content elevated by feedback and data.
  • Be a key driving force behind the development, engagement, and iterations of Sales and Engineering bootcamp programs.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience driving the development of L&D initiatives in a high-growth startup or late-stage tech environment.
  • Experienced leveraging LMS systems like Docebo, e-learning platforms, intranet solutions, and instructional design tools like Articulate to deliver impactful learning experiences.
  • Exceptional collaboration and interpersonal skills, with a strong customer-centric approach to building relationships and delivering outstanding service to stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to analyse training metrics, evaluate impact, and translate findings into actionable recommendations to enhance learning solutions.
  • Demonstrated skill in translating business objectives into innovative, engaging, and practical learning solutions that drive measurable results.


Values

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the centre of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed : We move fast, stay agile and favour action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward : We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

title: Gerente de planejamento comercial
description:
Vaga: Gerente de Planejamento Comercial

Localização: Rio de Janeiro, RJ


Estruturar e gerenciar o planejamento estratégico das coleções, liderando a equipe de especialistas, analistas e assistentes de planejamento com foco no ciclo de vida do produto e na otimização do merchandising.

O profissional será responsável por garantir a assertividade do mix de produtos, gerenciar o orçamento de compras (OTB) e otimizar os níveis de estoque, visando maximizar as vendas, o giro e a rentabilidade do negócio, enquanto desenvolve e orienta seu time.


Principais Responsabilidades


1. Planejamento de Produto e Coleção (Pré-Temporada):

  • Análise de Performance: Supervisionar a análise de dados históricos de vendas (curva de produtos, categorias, atributos) para identificar tendências, oportunidades e riscos.
  • Construção do OTB (Open-to-Buy): Desenvolver e gerenciar o orçamento de compras (OTB) por coleção e categoria, alinhado às metas financeiras da companhia.
  • Definição do Sortimento (Mix): Liderar as discussões com as áreas de Estilo e Compras para definir a arquitetura da coleção (pirâmide de produtos, mix, amplitude vs. profundidade).
  • Planejamento de Demanda: Garantir a acuracidade do forecast de vendas e da projeção de necessidades de compra (compra inicial vs. reposição).

2. Planejamento de Merchandising (Durante a Temporada):

  • Gestão de Estoque: Monitorar e direcionar o time na análise da performance do estoque (cobertura, giro, sell-through) e no gerenciamento do fluxo de produtos.
  • Alocação e Abastecimento: Definir e supervisionar a estratégia de distribuição inicial (alocação) e o plano de reposição (abastecimento) para as lojas e canais.
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida: Orientar a equipe na identificação de produtos (Best Sellers, Slow Movers) e liderar a proposição de ações comerciais (promoções, remarcações) para otimizar o ciclo de vida.
  • Planejamento de Liquidação: Estruturar a estratégia de markdown (remarcação) ao final da coleção, visando a limpeza do estoque com o mínimo impacto na margem.

3. Gestão de Equipe e Performance:

  • Liderança e Desenvolvimento: Liderar, treinar e desenvolver a equipe de analistas e planejadores, orientando as entregas diárias e promovendo o crescimento profissional do time.
  • Gestão de Desempenho: Definir metas e KPIs para a equipe, acompanhando a performance individual e coletiva através de feedbacks e planos de desenvolvimento.
  • Controle de Qualidade: Assegurar a precisão, a qualidade e o cumprimento de prazos de todas as entregas, relatórios e análises da área.
  • Consolidação de KPIs: Ser o guardião dos indicadores de planejamento (Giro, Cobertura, Sell-Through, Margem, GMROI), consolidando os resultados e criando planos de ação.
  • Interface Estratégica: Liderar a interface e atuar como o principal ponto de contato entre as áreas de Compras, Estilo, Logística e Vendas, garantindo o alinhamento do planejamento.


Requisitos Essenciais


  • Experiência: Sólida experiência prévia em Planejamento Comercial, Produto ou Merchandising, adquirida obrigatoriamente no Varejo de Moda.
  • Gestão de Pessoas: Comprovada experiência em gestão de equipes (supervisão, coordenação ou gerência), mesmo que de times pequenos.
  • Competências Técnicas:
  • Domínio avançado em Excel (modelagem, tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas complexas).
  • Profundo conhecimento em gestão de OTB (Open-to-Buy).
  • Ampla vivência com os principais indicadores de varejo (KPIs) e do ciclo de vida do produto.
  • Perfil:
  • Capacidade de liderar, inspirar e desenvolver pessoas.
  • Perfil altamente analítico, estruturado e com forte raciocínio lógico.
  • Habilidade de transformar dados complexos em insights acionáveis.
  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de negociar e influenciar áreas parceiras.
  • Formação: Superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Moda (com foco em Negócios) ou áreas correlatas.


Diferenciais (Desejável)


  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Varejo, Finanças ou Negócios ou afins.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de Business Intelligence (Power BI, Tableau).
  • Experiência com planejamento em múltiplos canais (Omnichannel - Lojas Físicas e E-commerce).

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.

Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Marketing Coordinator to join our growing team!


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in.   • Nerdiness is a bonus! If you love D&D, Pokémon, video games, or books, we’ll get along just fine!


Purpose of the Role


The Marketing Coordinator role combines project coordination with client relationship management, acting as a bridge between internal teams and clients. This role supports smooth project execution by managing internal communication, task coordination, and ensuring that all client deliverables are met on time, within budget, and to the highest standard. You'll be integral in managing both the marketing efforts and client interactions, translating client goals into actionable tasks, and ensuring the process runs seamlessly from start to finish.


Main Objectives


1-Client Collaboration & Project Oversight:

  • Collaborate with clients to understand their marketing goals and expectations.
  • Translate these goals into clear tasks for the Marketing Coordinator, ensuring smooth project execution.
  • Regularly meet with clients to review deliverables, adjust timelines, and maintain strong relationships.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, providing updates, addressing concerns, and ensuring satisfaction.


2-Internal Team Coordination:

  • Work closely with designers, copywriters, media buyers, and other team members to develop high-quality marketing materials across all service offerings.
  • Organize internal kick-off meetings, assign tasks, and ensure that everything stays on schedule and within scope.
  • Provide clear direction and thoughtful feedback to internal teams to ensure work meets or exceeds client expectations.
  • Ensure all project management tools (Asana, Trello, ClickUp) and Teamwork boards are up to date.


3-Communication & Task Management:

  • Manage meetings with clients, ensuring clear action plans and next steps.
  • Review and approve final deliverables before submission, making sure they meet client goals and expectations.
  • Use tools like Jiminny to document meetings, share important notes, and ensure all action items are tracked.
  • Keep all teams aligned through regular check-ins and updates, making sure deadlines are met and no tasks fall through the cracks.


4-Resource Planning & Problem Solving:

  • Manage multiple projects at once, ensuring each one is progressing smoothly, with no delays or miscommunication.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues, whether they relate to resources, deadlines, or client feedback.
  • Proactively anticipate problems and find creative solutions to keep projects on track.


5-Strategic & Process-Oriented Thinking:

  • Help shape the big-picture marketing strategy with the Senior Account Manager.
  • Continuously look for ways to improve internal workflows, ensuring efficiency and consistent delivery.
  • Build strong, positive relationships both within the team and with clients, helping to drive long-term success.


Additional Skills

  • Project Management: Skilled at managing timelines and juggling multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Verbal & Written Communication: Excellent communication skills—both internally and with clients.
  • Emotional Intelligence: Able to handle complex client personalities and stay calm under pressure.
  • Time Management: Proficient in balancing meetings, internal work, and client deliverables without missing a beat.
  • Presentation Skills: Comfortable leading client meetings and representing the agency confidently.


Our operating hours are from 9 am to 5 pm MST, Monday to Friday.

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now—let’s get talking, get making, and go get that bacon.

Atuação em uma empresa de grande porte do setor financeiro , com presença nacional e internacional , em um ambiente moderno, colaborativo e orientado a dados .

Este cargo ativa jornadas de consumidor multi-etapas e multi-canais , aplicando regras de negócio, lógica de personalização e táticas de canal para entregar mensagens relevantes em grande escala.

Embora não seja responsável pelo desenvolvimento de backend ou automações técnicas , o profissional utiliza ferramentas nativas da plataforma (ex.: Journey Builder, Send Flows, Entry Criteria, Wait Steps, etc.) para executar campanhas de forma eficiente e precisa — sem necessidade de código . É necessário ter forte fluência nas capacidades de ativação self-service e trabalhar em estreita colaboração com leads de audiência, conteúdo e QA para garantir que todos os componentes estejam devidamente integrados.

Como especialista prático na configuração de jornadas e implantação de campanhas , este cargo permite que as marcas do setor entreguem comunicações consistentes, pontuais e de alto impacto via e-mail, push e outros canais próprios.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Direção de Marketing & Ativação

  • Traduzir estratégias de CRM e Loyalty em jornadas multi-etapas usando ferramentas self-service nativas da plataforma (ex.: funcionalidades drag & drop do SFMC).
  • Construir e lançar jornadas em E-mail, Push e SMS , incorporando lógica como wait steps, decision splits e regras de personalização baseadas nos objetivos da campanha.
  • Validar se todos os inputs necessários (ex.: audiências, templates, links, textos legais) estão completos e funcionais antes da ativação.
  • Monitorar jornadas ao vivo para detectar problemas de performance ou sinais operacionais (ex.: erros de audiência, falhas de lógica) e executar ajustes em tempo real quando necessário para garantir a integridade da execução .

Dados, Métricas & Otimização

  • Garantir a implementação correta da lógica de segmentação, critérios de entrada, tempos de espera e limites de frequência , alinhada à estratégia.
  • Marcar jornadas com IDs de campanha, metadados e parâmetros de rastreamento para suportar relatórios precisos.
  • Colaborar com o Analista de Performance & Insights para compartilhar observações da plataforma e validar os resultados das campanhas pós-lançamento.

Otimização de Processos de Campanha

  • Identificar lógicas repetitivas entre campanhas e propor estruturas modulares de jornada para aumentar a eficiência e escalabilidade.
  • Manter documentação de melhores práticas de configuração de jornadas, checklists de QA de ativação e evolução dos padrões de execução.


Experiência e Habilidades Necessárias:

  • 3 a 5 anos de experiência em operações de CRM, ativação de campanhas ou marketing de ciclo de vida, preferencialmente em organizações grandes e multi-mercado .
  • Experiência prática em lançamento e gestão de campanhas em plataformas como Salesforce Marketing Cloud ou ESPs equivalentes.
  • Conhecimento funcional profundo de módulos da plataforma: Journey Builder, Email Studio, Mobile Studio e Automation Studio .
  • Capacidade comprovada de traduzir estratégia em jornadas , utilizando wait steps, decision splits, filtros e lógica de conteúdo dinâmico .
  • Experiência em gerenciar calendários de campanhas complexos , com habilidade para lidar com várias ativações simultâneas em diferentes canais .
  • Forte capacidade de troubleshooting , identificando e resolvendo problemas de configuração, falhas ou anomalias de performance de forma independente.
  • Alta atenção aos detalhes, orientação a processos e compromisso com a entrega impecável de campanhas .
  • Excelentes habilidades de colaboração para trabalhar com equipes de audiência, conteúdo, QA e tecnologia, garantindo alinhamento em todas as camadas de execução.


Qualificações:

  • Certificações Salesforce Marketing Cloud (ex.: Email Specialist, Marketing Cloud Administrator ) são desejáveis.
  • Experiência em ativação de programas de loyalty, design de jornadas de ciclo de vida do cliente ou personalização em escala .
  • Familiaridade com metodologias de QA de campanha e auditorias de execução .
  • Compreensão da lógica de dados (ex.: critérios de entrada, filtros de segmentação, lógica de exclusão) de um ponto de vista funcional, não de desenvolvimento .
  • Experiência em marketing digital, operações de marketing ou CRM em setores como CPG, varejo ou engajamento de consumidores em grande volume .


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?

  • Desenvolva sua Carreira : Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes : Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo : Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente : Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.


Nossos Valores

  • Cultura de Inovação : Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade : Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Nossos colaboradores lideram, aprendem e crescem, apoiando a si mesmos e a nossos clientes.

Good interpersonal skills.

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.


Objetivo do Cargo:

O Consultor de Ativação de Dados é responsável por transformar dados primários (1P data) em segmentos de audiência acionáveis que impulsionam campanhas de marketing personalizadas e orientadas por dados em múltiplos canais.

Essa função atua como líder funcional na criação e orquestração de audiências usando o Salesforce CDP e o Marketing Cloud , possibilitando ativações relevantes e oportunas sem necessidade de configuração técnica ou backend .

Com sólido conhecimento em modelos de dados, tabelas relacionais e lógica de segmentação , esse profissional faz a ponte entre as necessidades de negócio e as capacidades das plataformas — identificando os grupos de consumidores ideais com base em dados comportamentais, transacionais e declarados .

Ele assegura as melhores práticas de segmentação , garantindo preparo e precisão das campanhas e ativação eficaz em e-mail, mídia paga e outros pontos de contato endereçáveis.

Reportando-se ao líder de estratégia de CRM , esse cargo desempenha um papel fundamental na operacionalização da estratégia de dados primários (1P) — traduzindo objetivos estratégicos em definições precisas de audiência .

Trabalha em estreita colaboração com o Consultor de Ativação de Marketing , garantindo que a lógica das jornadas esteja alinhada ao design das audiências, e com as equipes técnicas globais de CDP , comunicando novas necessidades, validando viabilidades e solicitando atualizações no modelo de dados quando necessário.


Principais Responsabilidades:

1) Dados, Mensuração e Otimização

  • Manter-se atualizado sobre novas funcionalidades da plataforma (ex.: audiências preditivas, modelos lookalike, scores de propensão) e propor melhorias de segmentação mais inteligentes .


2) Marketing Direto e Ativação de Audiências

  • Traduzir objetivos estratégicos de dados 1P em planos de segmentação acionáveis , baseados em ciclo de vida, preferências, comportamentos e prioridades de negócio.

  • Assegurar que as regras de segmentação e definição de audiências estejam em conformidade com os padrões de governança de dados , políticas de privacidade e lógicas de opt-in/opt-out em todos os mercados e canais.

  • Atuar como especialista de referência em Salesforce CDP e nos fluxos de ativação de audiências , orientando equipes não técnicas sobre como solicitar e usar segmentos corretamente .

  • Identificar lacunas de dados ou problemas de usabilidade , propondo melhorias para aumentar a qualidade das segmentações e a eficiência operacional .


Experiência e Competências Necessárias:

  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, estratégia de CRM, operações de CDP ou campanhas orientadas por dados , preferencialmente em empresas de grande porte ou atuação multinacional.

  • Perfil analítico , com habilidade para traduzir objetivos estratégicos de audiência em lógicas de segmentação executáveis .
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de marketing direto (ex.: Salesforce Marketing Cloud) e com o processo de ativação de segmentos via e-mail, push, fidelidade e mídia paga .

title: CRA II or Senior CRA
description:
We are currently seeking a Clinical Research Associate to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Clinical Research Associate at ICON, you will play a pivotal role in designing and analyzing clinical trials, interpreting complex medical data, and contributing to the advancement of innovative treatments and therapies.
What You Will Be Doing
  • Completes onsite and remote monitoring activities in accordance with all ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, SOPs and study processes. Activities include qualifying potential investigative sites, initiating clinical trials, maintaining study files, providing instructions to site personnel and study close out.
  • Verifies the protection of study participants by confirming informed consent procedures and protocol have been performed in accordance to applicable regulations.
  • Ensures the integrity of clinical data and that the study is conducted in compliance with approved protocol, GCP, applicable regulations and SOPs.
  • Manages the investigative site staff to facilitate trial deliverables, e.g., subject enrollment, data deliverables.
  • Verifies proper management and accountability of Investigational Product (IP).
  • Writes and submits reports of investigational site findings and updates applicable tracking systems. Escalates observed deficiencies, issues, and corrective and preventative action plans as appropriate.
  • Manages essential documents as required by local regulations and ICH-GCP guidelines before, during and after a clinical study; assists with resolution of investigational site/data queries.
  • Performs key risk assessment and management responsibilities throughout the project, including key risk indicator and site health analysis, site process evaluation, and project escalation.
  • Participates in audit preparation and follow-up activities as needed.
  • Independently performs a variety of onsite and offsite monitoring visit types.
  • Gathers and reviews information for assigned siteand identifies inconsistencies. With limitedguidance from project and functional management, assesses risk and escalatesas appropriate.
  • Assists with non-complex adhoc, short-term assignmentin support of additional studies or departmental initiatives.

  • Undergraduate degree or international equivalent in clinical, science, or healthrelated field from an accredited institution; health care professional licensure, i.e., registered nurse
  • Previous experience supporting clinical trials including solid on-site monitoring experience in CROs or pharma companies.

title: Engenheiro de dados GCP

Este profissional terá papel fundamental no desenho, desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções de integração de dados confiáveis, escaláveis e seguras. O candidato ideal deve ter forte conhecimento em plataformas de nuvem, práticas modernas de engenharia de dados e perfil analítico para garantir o fluxo eficiente de dados na organização.

Responsabilidades Principais

Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines ETL/ELT para ingestão, transformação e entrega de dados estruturados e não estruturados.

Implementar frameworks de ingestão de dados a partir de múltiplas fontes (bancos de dados, APIs, arquivos, streaming etc.).

Garantir qualidade, consistência e confiabilidade dos dados por meio de validação, monitoramento e testes automatizados.

Otimizar fluxos de processamento de dados visando custo e performance.

Colaborar com Cientistas de Dados, Analistas e áreas de negócio para fornecer datasets limpos, confiáveis e bem documentados.

Trabalhar com serviços nativos de nuvem (ex.: BigQuery, Dataproc, Dataflow, Databricks, Snowflake) para implementar arquiteturas escaláveis.

Aplicar boas práticas de CI/CD, versionamento e Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) em pipelines de dados.

Assegurar conformidade com normas de segurança, governança e privacidade (ex.: PII, GDPR, LGPD).

Qualificações Necessárias

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
WHO ARE WE?


We’re a fast-growing consumer brand group selling across e-commerce, TikTok Shop, and Amazon. We prioritize direct-response strategy, product quality, and measurable efficacy. The team moves fast and operates with a high bar.


WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?


We’re hiring a Creative Strategist with heavy direct response experience.


You’ll own both strategy and ops: building and briefing angles, scripting iterations, managing sprints, reviewing edits, and ensuring we ship 100–200 ads per week.


You must have lived and breathed direct response advertising and VSL-style creative—knowing the beats, pacing, proof, and psychology that drive conversions. This is a hands-on IC role with pod-level ownership (no formal people management).


Focus split:

● ~60% Strategy/Briefing

● ~40% Creative Ops/QA/Delivery


HOW TO APPLY: If you believe we're the right fit, please fill in this form:


WHAT WILL YOU DO?


Direct Response Strategy / Briefing / Analysis

● Develop a creative strategy by offer, funnel, and awareness stage; publish weekly test plans.

● Generate net-new DR angles from learnings, competitor swipes, and cultural trends.

● Outline 2–3 minute VSL-style ads (problem, agitation, solution, proof, CTA) and collaborate with copy on scripting.

● Write iteration briefs (hook swaps, lead/body edits, CTA tests, packaging, captions) with clear hypotheses.

● Brief content creators with DR talking tracks, shot lists, compliance guardrails, and demo guidelines.

● Lead reviews to ensure DR structure, pacing, and storytelling are dialed in.

● Translate performance data (Hook, Hold, CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS) into new test briefs within 1–3 days.


Creative Ops & Delivery

● Own weekly sprints: intake → brief → production → QA → launch → iteration.

● Plan and ship 100–200 ads weekly (mix of new and iterations).

● Traffic assets correctly: naming, specs (9:16 / 4:5 / 1:1), captions, UTMs.

● QA assets for typos, compliance, pacing, audio, and render quality.

● Review editor work with time-stamped, DR-specific notes (cut logic, proof beats, motion/graphics, sound).

● Maintain a clean, searchable DAM with version control.

● Coordinate with Media/Growth to ensure launches hit deadlines.

● Use light automation/AI for cut-downs, resizing, and captions.

● Track throughput and ensure weekly volume targets are met without errors.

● Manage creator usage rights and content expirations.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (FIRST 90 DAYS)

● 100–200 DR ads shipped weekly , >98% QA pass rate .

● Iterations launched within 24–48 hours of insights , increasing win rate.

● Faster time-to-first-winner and more winners per 50 launches.

● A standardized system for DR briefs (VSL, creator, iteration) used by the team.

● Clean DAM and clear creative pipeline visible to Growth/Media .


MUST-HAVES

● 3+ years in direct response creative strategy, ideally in high-spend environments ($1MM+/mo).

● Deep experience with VSL-style ads : structure, beats, proof, pacing, CTA flow.

● Proven ability to ship 100–200 ads weekly across VSLs, short-form, and UGC.

● Strong post-production literacy (Premiere/Final Cut/AE basics) for precise DR feedback.

● Track record of writing/briefing iterations and content creators for DR assets .

● Data-driven mindset; you live in Hook/Hold/CTR/CPC/CPA/ROAS.

● Detail-oriented; errors don’t slip past you.

● Clear communicator who pushes creative toward DR performance.


NICE-TO-HAVES

● Health, beauty, or OTC-adjacent experience.

● Amazon and TikTok Shop creative systems.

● Familiarity with tools: ClickUp/Asana, Frame.io, Motion/Varos, Google Workspace, CapCut/Descript, Runway/Topaz/ElevenLabs

title: Staff ML Engineer
description:

About the Role

We are looking for our first Staff Machine Learning Engineer to establish and lead our machine learning initiatives. This is a critical, foundational role where you will have the unique opportunity to shape the future of data science and ML at Niche. You will be responsible for identifying high-impact opportunities, designing, building, and deploying machine learning models that directly drive business growth and enhance user experience across our platform.

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on practitioner who is passionate about translating business challenges into data-driven solutions. You build, you code, you ship, you measure. What You Will Do

Our first area of focus is our Recommendations, which includes matching students with the right schools
  • Design & Build: Lead the end-to-end development of machine learning models – from data collection and feature engineering to algorithm selection, training, tuning, and validation. This is a hands-on coding role

  • Measure & Iterate: Define key performance metrics, establish robust monitoring frameworks, analyze model performance in production, and drive continuous improvement through iteration and experimentation
  • Champion & Evangelize: Clearly communicate complex ML concepts, model behaviors, and results to both technical and non-technical audiences. Champion the use of machine learning & data science across the organization
  • Lead & Mentor: Establish ML development best practices, coding standards, and documentation. As the function grows you will guide and mentor other ML engineers
  • Innovate: Stay abreast of the latest advancements in machine learning, data science, and MLOps, evaluating and potentially adopting new technologies and techniques relevant to Niche

During the 1st Month:

  • Learn about Niche by meeting with various team members to learn more about our company through our Onboarding meetings

  • feedback loops

  • strategies
  • Establish early ML development workflows, documentation, andperformance monitoring
  • Contribute production-ready code for feature engineering and modelexperimentation

Within 6 Months:

  • Drive measurable improvements through experimentation and model iteration
  • Introduce scalable MLOps practices to support deployment, retraining, and governance
  • Serve as a mentor and set engineering best practices for a growing ML function

Within 12 Months:

  • Lead ML efforts across multiple product areas, driving business impact at scale
  • Influence company-wide strategy through technical leadership and ML evangelism
  • Develop internal tooling, reusable frameworks, and scalable ML systems
  • Help grow the team through hiring, mentorship, and a culture of innovation


What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 8+ years of professional experience in software development or data science, with at least 5+ years specifically focused on building and deploying machine learning models in a production environment
  • Proven Impact: Demonstrable track record of successfully shipping multiple machine learning models that resulted in measurable business growth (e.g., increased user engagement, conversion rates, operational efficiency, revenue). You can clearly articulate the business problem, the ML solution, and the quantitative impact achieved
  • Technical Depth (Hands-On):
  • Expertise in Python and common ML libraries/frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, XGBoost)
  • Deep understanding of core ML concepts (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, recommendation systems, NLP, time series analysis, experimentation, model evaluation)
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets and data processing tools (e.g., Pandas, Spark)
  • Experience with ML deployment patterns and MLOps principles (e.g., model serving, monitoring, CI/CD for ML, feature stores)
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) is essential
  • Business Acumen: Strong ability to understand business needs, translate them into well-defined ML problems, and connect technical work back to strategic objectives. You prioritize work based on potential business impact
  • Leadership Experience: Experience or a strong aptitude for leading technical projects, defining technical direction, and mentoring others. Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Education: MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, OR equivalent practical experience demonstrating deep expertise in machine learning


Bonus Points

  • Experience building ML capabilities from the ground up
  • Experience with recommendation systems, search ranking algorithms, or NLP applied to user-generated content
  • Experience in the EdTech or consumer-facing platform space
  • Familiarity with golang, express, Postgres, Snowflake, DBT, and Tableau

description:

About TMF Group

TMF Group is a leading provider of critical administrative services, helping clients invest and operate safely around the world. We provide legal, financial, and employee administration through TMF Group’s teams in 120 offices.

Our 9,100 experts and 120 offices in 85 jurisdictions worldwide serve corporates, financial institutions, asset managers, private clients and family offices, providing the combination of accounting, tax, payroll, fund administration, compliance and entity management services essential to global business success.

We help businesses achieve global compliance, transparency and consistency.

We are seeking a skilled and proactive M365 and IAM Engineer to manage, secure, and optimize our Microsoft 365 environment and Identity & Access Management systems , On-Prem and Azure Active directory , Pas Services.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with M365 services, Azure Active Directory, and IAM tools, ensuring secure and seamless access to enterprise resources.

Microsoft 365 Administration:

Security & Compliance:

- Respond to security incidents related to identity and access.

- Ensure compliance with regulatory standards


Key Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

- 3–5 years of experience in M365 administration and IAM.

- Strong knowledge of Azure AD, Active Directory, and M365 security features.

- Experience with IAM tools

- Excellent troubleshooting and communication skills.

title: Salesforce Developer / Integration Specialist (Specright & Interius)

  • Develop and troubleshoot Salesforce Dataloader scripts and data automation tools.
  • Create and maintain data flow diagrams, mappings, and technical documentation for integrations.
  • Troubleshoot integration and data synchronization issues across Salesforce and Azure environments.

Platform Configuration

  • Configure Specright workflows, templates, and user roles based on business needs.
  • Optimize platform performance and usability.
  • Support supplier onboarding , including portal access and user training.

Application & Technical Support

  • Monitor integration health and performance, identifying improvement opportunities.

Business Analysis & Collaboration

  • Partner with business users to gather and validate integration requirements .
  • Document use cases, functional and technical specifications.
  • Participate in workshops with cross-functional teams (Packaging, Procurement, Quality, Supply Chain).
  • Support knowledge transfer and internal team training for long-term solution sustainability.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Skills

  • Strong understanding of Specright PDMS and Salesforce architecture.
  • Proven experience with API development and integrations (REST/SOAP, JSON, XML).
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure tools (Logic Apps, API Management, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Dataloader and Specright Data Loader .
  • Knowledge of authentication mechanisms such as OAuth, SSO, and token-based access.
  • Expertise in data mapping and transformation across enterprise systems.

Functional Skills

  • Strong business analysis and documentation capability.
  • Understanding of packaging data management or supplier collaboration processes .
  • Experience in regulated environments with compliance or audit requirements.
  • Excellent communication and ability to work independently in remote, cross-functional settings.

Experience Requirements

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
For Brazil Only, PJ contract, Fluent English


Position: Senior Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Work Hours: Must have overlap with U.S. Central Time

Start Date: Immediate

Contract Type: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica)

Duration: 3-4 months

Language Requirement: Fluent English required ( U.S.-based company)


Summary

We’re looking for an experienced QA Engineer who ramps up quickly on complex business domains and turns that understanding into clear, risk-based test strategies. You’ll combine strong manual testing skills with proven test case design and automation in .NET (C#) to raise the bar on quality across web, API, and data flows. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and DevOps to deliver reliable, testable, and observable software continuously.


What You’ll Do

  • Translate business processes into tests: Rapidly learn product/domain concepts and map endtoend workflows into highvalue test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
  • Design and execute test suites: Build and maintain comprehensive manual and automated tests (UI, API, integration, regression, smoke, and exploratory).
  • Build .NET automation: Develop and maintain C# test automation frameworks (e.g., Playwright , Selenium WebDriver , SpecFlow BDD , NUnit/xUnit/MSTest ) aligned to SOLID and POM principles.
  • Enable CI/CD quality gates: Integrate automated tests into pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps , GitHub Actions ) with parallel runs, test reporting, and flaky-test management.
  • Collaborate across disciplines: Work with Product Owners to refine acceptance criteria, with Developers to shift-left quality, and with business users to validate in staging/preproduction environments and in production once deployed.

title: Sr. Customer Success Analyst
description:
Title: Sr. Customer Support Analyst

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Location: Brazil, Remote


Graphic Communications( a CAI Division) is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries. Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy that Graphic Communications succeeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at


As a Sr. Customer Support Analyst , you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Customer Success , you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues.


Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy.
  • Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence.
  • Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact.
  • Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions.
  • Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment.
  • Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance.
  • Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution.
  • Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions.
  • Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details.
  • Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases.
  • Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics.
  • Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers.
  • Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity.
  • Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates.
  • Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements.
  • Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required.


Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities

  • Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front-end issues, and identify JavaScript or API failures.
  • Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or cURL.
  • Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers.
  • Configure and troubleshoot Windows ADFS Servers and perform remote diagnostics via VPN, RDP, or similar tools.
  • Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries.
  • Utilize network tracing tools (e.g., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues.
  • Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues.
  • Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET-based applications and related components.
  • Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments.
  • Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators.


Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience.
  • ERP/MIS background preferred.
  • Print industry knowledge is mandatory.
  • Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
  • Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Ability to solve problems efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work with minimal guidance.
  • Confident in delegating tasks and providing peer guidance.
  • Willing to work in shifts as required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Strong documentation and organizational abilities.
  • Data analysis skills (reports, dashboards, and metrics).
  • Proficient in general computing, internet research, and email communication.
  • Understanding of web development, SSO, Active Directory, and SSL.
  • Hands-on experience with VPN configuration, network management, and SQL scripting.


Education

  • Degree in Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience in customer support and enterprise systems.
  • Strong understanding of software troubleshooting, printing workflows, and IT infrastructure preferred.

title: Especialista em segurança
description:
A Stone está com uma oportunidade em seu time de Segurança em Desenvolvimento (AppSec) na área de Segurança da Informação para trabalhar com foco em projetos de Inteligência Artificial, em especial interfaces conversacionais! Você gosta de buscar novos desafios e adquirir novos conhecimentos para acelerar o desenvolvimento de carreira? Se sim, venha fazer parte do nosso time de Segurança da Informação, como Analista de Segurança em Desenvolvimento Senior na Stone!

O time de AppSec tem como propósito garantir que os aplicativos sejam desenvolvidos, mantidos e utilizados de maneira segura e protegida contra ameaças cibernéticas. Buscamos evitar que nossos sistemas tenham vulnerabilidades que possam ser exploradas por criminosos cibernéticos, visando proteger dados sensíveis, a privacidade dos usuários e a integridade das aplicações.


Como é ser Analista de Segurança em Desenvolvimento Senior?


Dentre as atividades de trabalho esperadas, estão:


Estratégia, Colaboração e Arquitetura Segura em IA:

  • Ser o ponto focal de segurança, colaborando diretamente com times de engenharia em projetos de Inteligência Artificial.
  • Participar e conduzir ativamente revisões de arquitetura para sistemas baseados em IA, desde a concepção até a fase de produção.
  • Realizar threat modeling específico para identificar e mitigar vetores de ataque exclusivos de sistemas de IA.
  • Desenvolver e manter um programa de segurança, abrangendo atividades defensivas e ofensivas, para aplicações de Inteligência Artificial Generativa (GenAI).

Domínio de Riscos e Vulnerabilidades de Segurança em IA:

  • Possuir profundo conhecimento em riscos de segurança e privacidade específicos de IA, incluindo (mas não limitado a) o OWASP Top 10 for LLMs :
  • Prompt Injection e técnicas de jailbreak.
  • Insecure Output Handling e riscos de execução de código.
  • Data Poisoning em datasets de treino/fine-tuning.
  • Model Denial of Service e ataques de exaustão de recursos.
  • Vulnerabilidades na cadeia de suprimentos (Supply Chain) de modelos, dados e dependências.
  • Vazamento de Informações Sensíveis (Sensitive Information Disclosure).
  • Insecure Plugin Design e riscos associados a tool/function calling.
  • Excessive Agency em sistemas e agentes autônomos.
  • Ataques de Inversão de Modelo e Inferência de Membro (Model Inversion/Membership Inference Attacks).
  • Roubo de Modelo (Model Theft).

Segurança em Arquiteturas e Componentes Específicos de IA:

  • Avaliação de Pipelines RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation): Foco em segurança de Vector databases, embeddings, estratégias de chunking e manipulação/injeção de contexto.
  • Revisão de Sistemas de Agentes Autônomos: Análise de limites de execução de tools/functions, segurança de memória/contexto persistente do agente e transparência de raciocínio (chain-of-thought).
  • Protocolos e Integrações: Avaliar a segurança do Model Context Protocol (MCP) e integrações.
  • Fluxos de Fine-tuning: Analisar workflows de fine-tuning e riscos de injeção de backdoors.
  • Controles de Segurança: Validar a implementação de guardrails e sistemas de filtragem de conteúdo (content filtering).

Governança, Compliance e Maturidade em IA:

  • Aplicar frameworks de avaliação de maturidade em segurança de IA (ex: OWASP AI Maturity Assessment).
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre regulamentações emergentes (ex: AI Act, Executive Orders) e suas implicações técnicas.
  • Implementar controles de privacidade diferencial e minimização de dados.
  • Estabelecer políticas de governança de modelos e versionamento seguro.

Capacidades Técnicas e Operacionais:

  • Ciclo de Vida de LLMs: Conhecimento aprofundado em pre-training, fine-tuning, RLHF, alignment, padrões de deployment (API-based, on-premise, edge) e implicações de segurança do prompt engineering.
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Implementar a detecção de model drift, bias drift, concept drift e métricas de segurança (ex: toxicity scores, jailbreak attempts, PII leakage). Realizar anomaly detection e auditoria de prompts e outputs.
  • Infraestrutura de IA em Cloud: Experiência com serviços gerenciados de LLM (ex: AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI), segurança de containers para workloads de ML/AI, gerenciamento de segredos (secrets management) e isolamento de rede.

Testes e Validação de Segurança:

  • Conduzir security assessments de aplicações baseadas em LLM utilizando metodologias específicas.
  • Realizar exercícios simulando ataques como prompt injection, jailbreak, cenários de exfiltração de dados e adversarial inputs.
  • Validar controles de rate limiting, prevenção de abuso e gerenciamento de custos.
  • Testar sandboxing e isolamento para execução de código.


Outras Contribuições e Habilidades:

  • Avaliar riscos e definir requisitos e padrões de segurança.
  • Realizar revisões de código e design de arquitetura.
  • Implementar testes de segurança automatizados e auxiliar na mitigação e correção de vulnerabilidades.
  • Promover o treinamento e a sensibilização dos times de desenvolvimento.
  • Integrar segurança de forma eficiente nos processos de desenvolvimento (shift-left).
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências de segurança em IA.
  • Utilizar a experiência e intuição de segurança para buscar ameaças nos ambientes corporativos e de produção.
  • Ter iniciativa para buscar ou solicitar dados importantes que estejam ausentes.
  • Desenvolver soluções criativas e complexas que equilibrem riscos e necessidades de negócio.
  • Capacidade plena de leitura e comunicação eficiente em inglês.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Ter capacidade de identificar oportunidades de melhorias, novas soluções e alertas que possam beneficiar e/ou facilitar a operação
  • Usar habilidades de influência e negociação para direcionar os times a corrigirem problemas ou a utilizar arquiteturas adequadas do ponto de vista de segurança
