title: Inviting Senior Editors of EI Compendex Journals
description:
We are a seasoned academic service team dedicated to advancing international scholarly exchange and collaboration. To better support researchers worldwide in disseminating their work, we are now seeking experienced professionals like you—with a background as an editor or special issue organizer for EI Compendex-indexed journals —to join our expert team and contribute to elevating the quality and impact of academic papers.


We Are Looking For Candidates with the Following Profile:

  • A strong academic research background and a respected reputation in your field.
  • Must possess one of the following senior-level experiences:
  • Must currently be organizing and guest-editing a Special Issue for an EI Compendex-indexed journal.
  • Must currently be serving as an editor, associate editor, or editorial board member for an EI Compendex-indexed journal.


Your Role Will Include (Clear Academic Support Services):

  • Academic Review & Deep Polishing: Evaluate manuscripts for scientific rigor, logic, and originality, while refining academic expression, flow, and terminology to meet international publication standards.
  • Professional Translation & Grammar Polishing: Accurately translate Chinese research papers into natural, fluent academic English, ensuring correctness in grammar, spelling, and sentence structure.
  • Figure Optimization: Ensure all figures, charts, and images in the manuscript comply with the technical requirements of target journals, including but not limited to: format, layout, resolution (DPI), color mode, and file size.
  • Cover Letter Drafting: Assist authors in concisely summarizing the manuscript’s core strengths, innovations, and academic value in a compelling cover letter , enhancing its initial impression on journal editors.
  • Submission Assistance: Based on the article’s specific content, academic quality, and research field, recommend suitable journals indexed in the EI Compendex database for the author’s reference and selection.


Our Commitment and Emphasis (Core Compliance):

  • Full Compliance: All services we provide are strictly for “academic support” and absolutely do not involve any form of ghostwriting, data fabrication, or plagiarism . Your work will focus solely on improving the quality of the author’s original manuscript, with all final decisions remaining with the author.
  • No Acceptance Guarantee: We do not and cannot guarantee that any manuscript will be accepted. The final decision on publication rests entirely with the journal’s editors and peer-review process. Submission assistance is solely a recommendation based on content and does not imply any outcome.
  • Respect for Academic Integrity: We strictly adhere to publishing ethics standards (e.g., COPE guidelines). Our services are designed to help authors overcome language, presentation, and technical barriers, not to replace their core research work.


By Joining Us, You Will Receive:

  • Competitive remuneration and flexible working hours that fully respect your academic schedule.
  • Opportunities to engage with cutting-edge research and exchange ideas with outstanding global scholars.
  • The professional satisfaction of contributing to clearer, more standardized, and influential scientific communication.

If our mission resonates with you, and you wish to leverage your senior experience to help more scholars share their work globally, we sincerely invite you to get in touch.


We look forward to partnering with you in upholding the beacon of academic excellence!

title: Consultor de Recrutamento Júnior
description:
Recém-formado(a)? Fala inglês fluente e quer construir uma carreira onde sua renda depende diretamente dos seus esforços?

Nossa startup de recrutamento está buscando um(a) Consultor(a) de Recrutamento Júnior .

Não buscamos um especialista pronto. Buscamos alguém com "brilho nos olhos", que possamos treinar no verdadeiro modelo 360  (sim, isso inclui Vendas e Recrutamento!). Você estará na origem da empresa, trabalhando lado a lado com os fundadores.

O que você vai fazer (e o que vamos te ensinar):

  • Parte 1: Negociação e Vendas (Prospecção)
  • Prospectar e atrair novos clientes (B2B), usando LinkedIn e contatos "frios".
  • Aprender a negociar com Diretores de RH e CEOs, fechando contratos de R&S.
  • Desenvolver relações de longo prazo com as empresas, tornando-se um parceiro estratégico.
  • Parte 2: Recrutamento (Delivery)
  • Conduzir o ciclo completo de recrutamento (do briefing com o cliente até a oferta).
  • Fazer "hunting" ativo dos melhores candidatos do mercado, que não estão em busca de emprego.
  • Conduzir entrevistas, avaliar perfis e apresentar os candidatos aos clientes.

Nosso(a) candidato(a) ideal:

  • Possui Ensino Superior completo.
  • Fala Inglês em nível avançado/fluente (conversacional)  — você vai se comunicar com candidatos e clientes internacionais.
  • Tem excelentes habilidades de comunicação:  você não tem medo de telefone, sabe ouvir, articula bem as ideias e tem poder de persuasão.
  • Tem um enorme desejo de se desenvolver  em negociação (vendas) e recrutamento (R&S).
  • É autônomo(a), proativo(a) e pronto(a) para atuar no ambiente dinâmico de uma startup.

Experiência prévia em R&S ou vendas é um diferencial, mas seu desejo e suas habilidades de comunicação são mais importantes.

O que oferecemos:

  • 100% Remoto (Home Office):  Trabalhe de qualquer lugar do Brasil.
  • Treinamento intensivo no modelo 360:  Vamos investir em você e transformá-lo(a) em um(a) consultor(a) de ponta.
  • Plano de carreira transparente:  Critérios claros de crescimento de Júnior a Sócio(a).
  • Salário e Motivação:  Salário base  competitivo (CLT) + alta remuneração variável (comissão)  baseada em seus resultados comerciais.
  • Impacto direto no negócio:  Zero burocracia. Suas ideias serão ouvidas e implementadas.

Pronto(a) para construir sua carreira e mudar sua vida?

Envie seu currículo e uma breve carta de apresentação (em inglês ou português), explicando por que você quer ser um(a) consultor(a) 360.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil (Remote)


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview:


As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions to support the company's mission and goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities:


1. Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of

our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance,

reliability, and scalability.

2. Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and

support business processes

3. API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal

and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare

systems and third-party services.

4. Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare

industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining

robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities:


1. Mentor junior developers, providing guidance on best practices in

backend development, code review, and team collaboration.

2. Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to

continually innovate and enhance the platform.

3. Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint

planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of

high-quality software.

4. Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface

and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end

functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.


Competencies/Requirements:


1. Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL.

Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.

2. Experience: At least 5 years of experience in backend development, with a

proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web

applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is

highly desirable.

3. Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think

analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

4. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills,

capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and

stakeholders.

5. Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design

specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and

efficient platform.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth


Applications will only be considered with CVs submitted in English.

title: Full Stack Software Developer "#985259"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional no segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Participar de todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento ágil , desde design, implementação, testes e deployment.
  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações full stack, utilizando Angular no front-end e .NET (C#) ou Python no back-end.
  • Criar novas funcionalidades e infraestrutura para atender rapidamente necessidades de negócio emergentes.
  • Garantir performance, escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade das aplicações desenvolvidas.
  • Trabalhar com Azure Functions, Azure Storage e Azure Cosmos DB para soluções cloud-native.
  • Criar, manter e operar pipelines no Azure Data Factory (ADF) .
  • Realizar consultas e manipulação de dados utilizando SQL (nível intermediário) .
  • Atuar com CI/CD , especialmente em Azure DevOps e GitHub.
  • Acessar e executar operações básicas no Snowflake , incluindo uso de Python dentro da plataforma.
  • Colaborar com equipes globais e participar ativamente de reuniões técnicas em inglês.
  • Operar em um ambiente dinâmico (multistack), lidando com diferentes tecnologias e processos em constante evolução.


O que você precisa ter

  • 3+ anos de experiência como Full Stack Developer ou Back-end Developer com exposição ao front-end.
  • Experiência sólida com ao menos uma das linguagens de back-end : .NET (C#) ou Python
  • Experiência com Angular + TypeScript (UI já estabelecida).
  • Vivência com Azure (obrigatório), incluindo:
  • Azure Functions
  • Azure Storage
  • Azure Cosmos DB
  • Azure Data Factory (ADF) – criação e manutenção de pipelines
  • SQL intermediário .
  • Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD (Azure DevOps e GitHub) .
  • Abertura para trabalhar em ambiente ágil e multitecnologias.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com times técnicos e de negócio.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente (nível 5/5) – necessário para reuniões e discussões técnicas.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Experiência prévia com Snowflake.
  • Vivência com containers no Azure (Azure Container Apps/Registry).
  • Experiência com Visual Studio ou VS Code.
  • Capacidade de aprendizado rápido e adaptação a ambientes dinâmicos.
  • Forte senso de ownership, colaboração e atenção à qualidade do código.

title: Data Analyst
description:
TapGoods


TapGoods is an exciting, fast-growing start-up that is revolutionizing how rental companies optimize and grow their businesses. We’re working to make it easy to rent. 


There are tens of thousands of businesses in the US that provide event, tool, audiovisual, and recreation rentals. This fragmented $722 billion global industry has not yet adopted modern systems and instead relies on pen & paper or cobbles together dated technology solutions. We’re building a solution that modernizes and dramatically improves the rental process for both businesses and their customers. 


Our product engineering team uses agile processes to continuously deliver incremental functionality on a weekly basis. We are constantly evolving, looking at every sprint as an opportunity to celebrate our success and learn how to improve. 


Data Analyst Role


We need a Data Analyst to join our team to fulfill our customers’ reporting needs. Our cloud platform provides analytics and reporting to our customers to help them manage their rental business. We’ve built a data warehouse and are moving our canned reports into embedded Power BI reports. 


This role would work closely with the product team and engineers to take our reporting to the next level. 


Responsibilities 


  • Use Power BI to create reports using our data warehouse 
  • Look for insights in our data that can provide value to our customers 
  • Maintain the Snowflake data warehouse dimensional model 
  • Be a part of our engineering team 
  • Able to work fully remote with adequate internet speeds, workspace, zoom capabilities (good mic, headset, etc.), and multiple monitors 


Requirements 


  • 1-3 years of experience with SQL 
  • Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools 
  • Experience with Power Query M 
  • Experience with Snowflake data warehouse 
  • Understanding data models for OLAP vs OLTP 
  • Experience with dimensional modeling/star schemas 
  • An unstoppable internal drive 
  • A great attitude and work ethic 
  • Solution oriented, self starter, and team player 
  • SaaS experience is a plus 


Our Culture


We are a nimble, fast-growing startup with a fully remote work environment. We have different backgrounds and life experiences that create a highly motivated, empowered and productive team. 


We are all committed to excellent work, whether it be one task or a big project - we believe in sticking things out until they are finished, and in communicating as quickly and effectively as possible when things get in the way of completing promised work. We are committed to improving the lives of our customers through our platform and our genuine care for them.

title: Scrum Master Sr
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem uma oportunidade imediata para Scrum Masters experientes e com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e transformação de negócios através do lean-agile. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. Junte-se ao nosso time e seja um agente facilitador de resultados de negócios através dos conceitos de Business Agility, Lean, Agile, Kanban e SAFe.


O Scrum Master trabalhará com equipes de entrega ágil para aprimorar e habilitar o desempenho de nível de equipe e entrega de valor usando o Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).


Duties and Responsibilities:

· Coach de equipes referentes aos valores e princípios lean-agile;

· Facilitar cerimônias ágeis no nível de time (Retrospectiva, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Planning, Refining), garantindo o entendimento e engajamento total da equipe em tais;

· Promover o mindset e práticas de melhoria contínua para as equipes ágeis;

· Integração das melhores práticas e padrões de agilidade em um contexto altamente regulado;

· Fomentar o senso de responsabilidade compartilhada nas equipes e stakeholders;

· Facilitar a resolução de ou impedimentos existentes para os times;

· Gerenciar interdependências entre equipes ágeis;

· Trabalhar com Product Owners para apoiar o planejamento de Curto Prazo e evolução da definição/priorização do Backlog de produto do time;

· Proteger as equipes de interferências externas que possam impactar princípios de agilidade, produtividade da equipe e/ou estágio de formação da equipe;

· Participar e auxiliar na facilitação de todas as cerimônias em um ambiente ágil escalado (SAFe Essential);


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

· Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master/Agile Master (conhecimento será testado);

· Experiência em ambiente regido pelas cerimônias do SAFe

· Vivência de TI em projetos de desenvolvimento de soluções complexas e de alta disponibilidade

· Experiência com diferentes modelos, métricas e cerimônias no nível de equipe ágil

· Experiência com ferramentas de gerenciamento de trabalho ágil (Jira), incluindo configuração, planejamento e relatórios

· Capacidade promover agilidade em diferentes cenários sendo responsável por garantir que as equipes entendam e operem de acordo com os valores e princípios de agilidade

· Conhecimento em outros métodos e práticas ágeis além do Scrum

Minimum Education:

· Bachelor’s Degree

Required Certifications:

· Possuir certificação KMP, PSPM e MGT 3.0

· Possuir certificação SAFe (plus)


Other:

· English (plus)

title: Master Data Manager
description:
Vaga: MDM Tester – Híbrido em São Paulo


Estamos em busca de um(a) MDM Tester experiente e detalhista para se juntar ao nosso time e contribuir com o sucesso da nossa iniciativa de Master Data Management (MDM) .


A posição é híbrida em São Paulo , com a oportunidade de atuar em projetos de dados de grande porte e impacto global.


Como MDM Tester , você será responsável por investigar e resolver falhas de qualidade de dados, analisar fontes e processos de ingestão, além de garantir a precisão, consistência e confiabilidade dos dados mestres em diversos sistemas.


Responsabilidades

  • Testar e validar dados mestres, assegurando qualidade, consistência e precisão entre diferentes sistemas;
  • Investigar gaps de conhecimento e perfilar fontes de dados;
  • Analisar e validar datasets de sistemas de origem para suportar migração e relatórios;
  • Colaborar com times de negócio e tecnologia para garantir alinhamento em políticas de governança e qualidade de dados;
  • Apoiar fluxos e automações de dados, contribuindo com melhorias contínuas nos pipelines.


✅ Requisitos

  • 5+ anos de experiência em Data/ETL Testing ;
  • 6+ anos de experiência em gestão e governança de qualidade de dados em ambiente MDM;
  • Sólido conhecimento em modelagem de dados e integração de dados ;
  • Experiência com ferramentas ETL (Ab Initio, AWS Glue, Informatica, Alteryx);
  • Vivência com CI/CD (GitLab) e práticas de DevOps/DataOps ;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de colaboração com equipes multifuncionais.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com MDM em nuvem ;
  • Atuação prévia em projetos de migração, validação ou limpeza de dados em larga escala.
  • Experiência prática com Stibo MDM ;


Local e Modelo

  • Híbrido – São Paulo
  • Contrato PJ

title: Technical Sourcing Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote Technical Sourcing Specialist based in Latin America with 2+ years of experience and excellent English communication skills — both written and spoken.


You’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and connecting top technical talent — including software engineers, developers, and other IT professionals — through platforms like LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing channels.


At Velozient, we’re a fast-moving, growth-stage company that values smart, proactive people who love connecting with others and enjoy the challenge of finding the best talent. You’ll play a key role in building and nurturing a high-quality pipeline that drives our hiring success.


Responsibilities

  • Proactively source, identify, and engage technical candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, social media, referrals, and other creative sourcing channels.
  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future technical roles.
  • Partner closely with Recruiters and Resource Managers to deeply understand technical requirements and deliver high-quality leads.
  • Conduct initial outreach and screening conversations to assess technical fit, interest level, and alignment with open positions.
  • Develop targeted search strategies using advanced Boolean logic, filters, and data mining techniques.
  • Track sourcing activity and candidate engagement using internal systems and tools.
  • Stay up to date on market trends, technologies, and sourcing innovations to improve talent pipelines continuously.
  • Represent Velozient’s brand professionally and enthusiastically in all candidate interactions.
  • Support diversity sourcing initiatives and help drive inclusive hiring practices.



REQUIRED Experience:

  • Excellent English skills — both written and verbal.
  • Minimum of 1+ years of experience in candidate sourcing or talent acquisition, with a focus on technical roles (e.g., software engineering, IT, data, or product).
  • Proven experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools.
  • Strong understanding of Boolean search, technical keyword targeting, and sourcing best practices.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.


Preferred Experience:

  • University degree.
  • Prior experience sourcing for North American-based companies.
  • Experience in a growth-stage or entrepreneurial organization.



What YOU Get!

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!

  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment

description:
About the Role

We are looking for a structured, strict, and technically-minded Head of Quality Assurance who will build and lead one of the most critical operational units in the company.

Scope of responsibility:

  • Management of a team of 30+ remote assistants
  • Quality control of 5,000+ job applications/month (scaling to 10,000+)

Current situation:

  • Many manual review processes → we need automation
  • No structured onboarding for new assistants
  • No clear KPIs or performance-based motivation

Hire additional assistants

Build a full Quality Assurance system from scratch

  • Create clear requirements and tasks for developers
  • Test and launch automation tools
  • Utilize AI and scripts for monitoring

  • Automatic validation of application fields
  • Duplicate application detection
  • Performance dashboards and speed tracking
  • Quality alert system
  • Real-time monitoring tools

Team Management (15%)

  • KPI tracking and performance reviews
  • Escalation handling and issue resolution

People development:

  • Selective 1:1s
  • Coaching low performers

Continuous improvement (10%)

  • Implement best practices and standardization
  • Maintain operations documentation
  • Work with client complaints, root cause elimination

Requirements

Must-Have:

2+ years managing operational teams

  • Experience managing 20+ employees
  • Built processes from scratch
  • Preferably BPO/outsourcing/call center/EdTech

Strong systems thinking and discipline

  • SOPs, checklists, regulations, compliance
  • Precision and attention to detail
  • Ability to make difficult decisions (terminations, corrective action)

Technical competency

  • Understanding of automation & quality monitoring

Analytical approach

  • Metrics: quality %, speed, productivity, error rate

  • Data-driven decision-making

Experience in hiring & onboarding


Strong Plus:

BPO/outsourcing experience (data entry, support, back office)

Quality automation experience

Technical degree (engineering / CS / math)

Six Sigma/Lean/Kaizen knowledge

Experience scaling teams from 10 → 50+

QA/Quality Management certifications

title: Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:
About the Company

Diib is a company based out of Salt Lake City, Utah. Diib’s mission is to make internet marketing clearer for individuals who don’t know anything about it. Diib helps small and medium businesses to find new ways to grow with Actionable Analytics, Industry-Based Ranking, and Custom Learning Tracks. 250k websites use Diib. The product is AI for SEO and other internet marketing aspects.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer who is passionate about delivering high-quality software, ensuring robust system performance, and driving automation best practices. In this role, you will take ownership of end-to-end testing strategies, leveraging Python for comprehensive test automation across functional, non-functional, and white-box testing. You will also play a key role in maintaining monitoring systems to proactively identify issues in production environments.


Key Responsibilities

Test Automation & Framework Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable end-to-end (E2E) tests using Python, Playwright, and Pytest for both UI and API validation.
  • Integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) to support continuous delivery and provide fast feedback.
  • Implement and manage test data and environments to ensure reliable and repeatable test execution.

Test Planning & Strategy

  • Design, document, and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to define quality benchmarks and ensure test coverage for all requirements.

Functional and Non-Functional Testing

  • Execute detailed automated and manual tests across multiple platforms and devices to validate functionality, usability, and performance.
  • Ensure that systems meet reliability, scalability, and availability expectations, especially in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) .

White-box Testing

  • Work closely with developers to understand internal logic and architecture, enabling more effective code-level testing.
  • Utilize Python scripts to facilitate unit, integration, and service-level testing beyond traditional black-box methods.

Monitoring System Configuration

  • Manage application and infrastructure monitoring tools.
  • Establish alerts and dashboards to support proactive issue resolution and maintain uptime.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or Software Testing.
  • 3+ years of proficiency in Python for test automation, scripting, and framework development.
  • Demonstrable experience with modern testing frameworks/tools like Playwright and Pytest for effective and reliable E2E and API testing.
  • Proven experience working with and testing applications deployed in a Cloud Environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP) .
  • Solid experience setting up and maintaining test execution within CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) .
  • Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
  • Good knowledge of SQL is a must.
  • Familiarity with modern monitoring platforms (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana, Datadog, or similar).
  • Excellent analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.


Nice to have

  • Proficiency in performance and security testing tools (e.g., JMeter, OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite).
  • Experience in testing data pipelines or data warehouse solutions , particularly Amazon Redshift .
  • Familiarity with testing applications built on AI/ML platforms , such as AWS Bedrock (e.g., prompt validation, knowledge base testing, or guardrail evaluation).


What We Offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), and a flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.

Location: Brazil (Remote / Hybrid based on project needs)

  • Build, fine-tune, and deploy custom LLMs and multimodal AI models.
  • Own technical architecture, solution design, performance optimization, and deployment strategies.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 6+ years of professional experience in AI/ML engineering , including leadership responsibilities.

  • Deep expertise in the GCP AI/ML stack , including:
  • Vertex AI
  • Gemini
  • Vector Search
  • AI Studio / AI APIs
  • Strong experience with agent-oriented frameworks :
  • LangChain
  • LangGraph
  • CrewAI
  • Google ADK
  • Experience deploying ML models into production using CI/CD and MLOps .
  • Strong understanding of APIs, data engineering fundamentals, cloud-native deployment, and microservices.
  • Excellent communication and ability to lead technical discussions with global teams.


Preferred Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with multi-agent systems and advanced tool orchestration.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes , Docker , and cloud-native architectures.
  • Understanding of AI security, compliance, and responsible AI frameworks.
  • Experience working in global, distributed engineering teams.


Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About the Client

Our client is a global technology company specialized in large-scale cloud infrastructure, automation of distributed systems, and deep integration between hardware and software.

The engineering environment is highly technical, fast-paced, and built around autonomy, ownership, and solving complex infrastructure challenges at global scale.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer with a strong software engineering background and solid experience in automating complex infrastructure environments.

This is a high-impact, product-focused role , responsible for building tools, automation layers, APIs, and workflows that will be directly consumed by the company’s customers — not only internal teams.

This is not a traditional DevOps/Platform position focused on provisioning resources internally.

Here, you will be designing and engineering infrastructure automation as product , interacting with hardware, clusters, and low-level systems that power a global cloud offering.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop tools, automations, APIs, and infrastructure workflows used directly by end customers.
  • Build automation layers that interact with physical hardware and low-level components (state management, provisioning logic, control sequences, etc.).
  • Create and maintain internal backends and integrations linking services, infrastructure, and the core platform.
  • Leverage programming languages — especially Python — to design robust and scalable automation solutions.
  • Work on the automation behind global infrastructure and distributed clusters.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and architectural decisions.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement within the platform and proactively propose solutions.


Technical Requirements

  • Senior-level experience in software development , especially with Python.
  • Strong background in infrastructure automation and distributed environments.
  • Experience working with hardware , data centers, bare-metal environments, or infrastructure-heavy companies.
  • Solid understanding of APIs, internal workflows, provisioning automation, and backend integrations.
  • Ability to work in low-level contexts involving hardware components and state management.
  • Proven experience building solutions from scratch , not only executing predefined tasks.


Cultural & Behavioral Profile

  • High autonomy: must be able to discover opportunities, define approaches, and drive solutions independently.
  • Seniority and maturity to operate within a team of highly experienced engineers.
  • Hands-on, proactive mindset, with strong ownership and problem-solving orientation.
  • Experience in fast-paced environments (startups or mixed small/large company backgrounds).
  • Curiosity and flexibility to learn new technologies and navigate cross-disciplinary areas.


English Requirement

  • Advanced English is mandatory , as the leadership and part of the engineering team are international.


What Will Not Fit

  • Junior or mid-level professionals.
  • Candidates who only worked in slow, highly structured corporate environments.
  • Profiles focused solely on execution or maintenance (not creation).
  • Professionals who depend heavily on direction and lack technical autonomy.


Contract Model

  • PJ / Contractor (LLC) — engagement through independent contractor arrangement.
  • The candidate must be legally able to invoice through a company (LLC or equivalent).


Work Model

  • Remote (remote-friendly).
  • The company has no restrictions regarding location, as long as the candidate meets performance expectations and availability for team collaboration.


Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on the core product , not just internal tooling.
  • Unique combination of software + hardware + global infrastructure engineering .
  • High autonomy and opportunity to design new components from scratch.
  • Collaboration with a senior, highly technical engineering team.

description:
Company Description:

Mojo Trek, an Inc. 5000 company, delivers an unparalleled technology recruitment experience, grounded in transparency and integrity. From midsize technology innovators to Fortune 50 powerhouse corporations, we help our clients build technology teams that make a difference. In addition to our strong presence in the Midwest and New York, we maintain an international footprint that enhances our ability to serve clients on a global scale.


We’re looking for a Senior Agile Tester who thrives in fast-moving, cross-functional environments and is passionate about ensuring quality from concept to deployment. You’ll collaborate closely with front-end developers, designers, and backend engineers to validate user experiences across responsive, content-driven applications built with modern technologies like React, Next.js, and headless CMSs.


Your mission is to advocate for quality across the entire product lifecycle — from exploratory testing and API validation to automation and continuous improvement within an agile delivery model.


Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with developers, designers, and product owners in agile ceremonies to define and validate acceptance criteria.
  • Design and execute test plans for web applications using React / Next.js, ensuring responsive behavior across devices and browsers.
  • Test CMS integrations (Contentful, Strapi, Sanity) and validate localization and marketing content workflows.
  • Verify API Gateway / BFF layer integrations, ensuring clean data aggregation and performance across multiple channels.
  • Conduct exploratory, regression, and usability testing for front-end components built with Tailwind CSS and Storybook systems.
  • Validate deployments built via Vite for performance, caching, and build integrity.
  • Collaborate with developers to identify, report, and track defects using modern issue-tracking tools (e.g., Jira).
  • Contribute to test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines for both UI and API test coverage.
  • Ensure accessibility, performance, and content accuracy across localized experiences.


Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in quality assurance or software testing, preferably within agile or scrum environments.
  • Strong understanding of frontend architectures (React, Next.js, or similar).
  • Experience testing RESTful APIs, CMS integrations, or decoupled web applications.
  • Proficiency with modern testing frameworks and tools (e.g., Cypress, Playwright, Postman, Jest).
  • Familiarity with design systems and component-based testing (Storybook or similar).
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively within agile teams.
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a passion for continuous improvement and quality advocacy.


Nice to Have

  • Experience testing Drupal APIs and integrations with headless front-ends.
  • Knowledge of Vite builds, SSR, and hybrid rendering performance considerations.
  • Exposure to visual regression testing tools like Percy or Chromatic.
  • Familiarity with automated cross-browser and device testing suites.


What You’ll Get

  • Opportunity to shape quality practices in a modern, front-end–driven product ecosystem.
  • Collaboration with an innovative design and development team using cutting-edge tools.
  • Flexible work environment focused on learning, iteration, and delivering exceptional user experiences.

title: Platform Operations Team Lead (Brazil-based)
description:
About the Role

Mindhive builds AI-powered vision systems that transform industrial production. As we scale globally, reliability, observability, and rapid issue response are critical. The Platform Operations Team Lead (Brazil) plays a central role in ensuring our systems remain healthy across LATAM and European time zones.

You will lead the Platform Operations function — the customer-adjacent, reliability-focused counterpart to our Platform Engineering team in New Zealand. Your team will ensure our deployed systems are monitored, stable, recoverable, and well-understood by the rest of the business.

This role focuses on:

  • monitoring, alert quality, and fast incident response
  • supporting on-premise and edge deployments
  • improving operational processes and tooling
  • follow-the-sun coverage across Brazil and Portugal
  • ensuring operational readiness for engineering-led upgrades

You will collaborate closely with the NZ-based Platform Engineering team, who drive deep engineering projects (Puppet 8 rollout, Python 3.13 upgrade, CDK migration, CI/CD consistency, platform hardening, test-rig reliability). Together, you will form Mindhive’s global reliability backbone.

title: Senior Test Engineer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Senior Test Engineer to join our growing team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.

title: Formação de Consultor de Investimentos CEA
description:
SOBRE O CLUBE DO VALOR:


O Clube do Valor foi fundado em 2015 com o objetivo de mudar, de verdade, a relação do brasileiro com o dinheiro. Com o passar do tempo, acertamos, erramos e aprendemos muito. Entendemos que, pra gente, o que importa mesmo são duas coisas: propósito (o que nos move) e cultura (o que somos e como agimos).


Nosso propósito é ambicioso: levar tranquilidade financeira para todos os brasileiros, para que cada um possa viver a vida dos seus sonhos. Para nos aproximarmos do nosso propósito, atuamos em duas frentes complementares: educação e gestão de investimentos. Já impactamos mais de 40 mil brasileiros com nossos conteúdos e ultrapassamos a marca de 5 bilhões de patrimônio sob aconselhamento.


NOSSOS VALORES:

Nosso conjunto de valores reflete o que é empreender e ser um sócio que gera VALOR para o CDV:


V alorizamos resultados, trabalho inteligente e duro;

A ssumimos o protagonismo do nosso crescimento;

L evamos integridade e transparência em tudo o que fazemos;

O bstinados em superar as expectativas de todos os Clubistas (clientes e audiência);

R econhecemos de forma meritocrática quem age como dono.


O QUE BUSCAMOS EM VOCÊ


Ensino superior ou técnico cursando/completo (qualquer curso);

Bom domínio da língua portuguesa, escrita e comunicação em geral;

Interesse/conhecimento mínimo sobre investimentos e finanças pessoais;

Abertura a desenvolvimento;

Perfil comercial e analítico;

Bom relacionamento interpessoal;

Residência em Porto Alegre/Região.


SOBRE A VAGA


O Clube do Valor oferece um Programa de Formação de Planejadores Financeiros (PFP) estruturado em cinco fases. Ao longo dessa jornada, você passará por uma imersão intensiva, desenhada para acelerar o desenvolvimento das suas habilidades comerciais, relacionais e técnicas, por meio de experiências teóricas e práticas. Durante todo o processo, você contará com o apoio da nossa área de Enablement, além do financiamento da certificação CEA oferecido pelo CDV.


Nosso objetivo é que você seja formado para atuar como um Planejador Financeiro, levando tranquilidade financeira para todos os brasileiros.


FASE 1: Onboarding e Foco Institucional


O objetivo dessa etapa é a sua integração na empresa, engajamento com o time, com a nossa cultura e o direcionamento dos seus primeiros passos na trilha de formação.


Seus principais focos serão:

Onboarding Institucional;

Imersão Cultural;

Onboarding de Pré-Vendas.


FASE 2: Máquina de Vendas


Nessa etapa, você será responsável pela qualificação dos investidores, focando no desenvolvimento de habilidades comerciais e geração de novas oportunidades de negócios.


Seus principais focos serão:

Desenvolver habilidades comerciais.

Realizar agendamentos;

Pitch comercial;

Geração de oportunidades;

Foco em resultado e atingimento de metas.


FASE 3: Especialista em Investimentos


O objetivo dessa etapa é a sua capacitação técnica, seja na visão geral do mercado financeiro, investimentos ou operacional.


Seus principais focos serão:

Conhecimento geral sobre o Mercado Financeiro;

Conquista da certificação CEA;

Estudo da Filosofia e Estratégias de Investimentos do CDV;

Conhecimento de BackOffice e Ferramentas Operacionais.


FASE 4: Especialista em Novos Negócios


O objetivo dessa etapa é a sua capacitação para atendimento e relacionamento com o cliente.Você segue se desenvolvendo comercialmente e também aprende a realizar um fechamento comercial e começa a formar sua base de clientes.


Seus principais focos serão:

Jornada e Relacionamento com o Cliente;

Fechamento Comercial;

Elaboração de Planejamento Financeiro.


FASE 5: Jornada do Cliente


O objetivo dessa etapa é seguir a sua capacitação para atendimento e relacionamento com o cliente, desenvolvendo a postura e a conduta de um planejador.


Seus principais focos serão:

Jornada e Relacionamento com o Cliente;

Postura e Conduta do Planejador.


NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS:


SAÚDE


Conexa Saúde: valorizamos o cuidado à saúde mental, por isso, custeamos 4 sessões de terapia/mês.

Plano de Saúde: valorizamos a saúde dos nossos colaboradores! Oferecemos adesão opcional ao plano de saúde Unimed, com custo acessível.

Total Pass: acesso à plataforma exclusiva com treinos, receitas, meditação, desconto em academias, entre outros.

Plano de Saúde Pet (Pet Love): Oferecemos acesso a planos de saúde para pets com condições especiais, garantindo cuidado e proteção para o seu pet. A adesão é opcional.

Seguro de Vida: Oferecemos uma solução personalizada de seguro de vida, com cashback de até 40% no primeiro ano de vigência da apólice.


EDUCAÇÃO E DESENVOLVIMENTO

Certificação de Especialista em Investimentos (CEA): como forma de incentivo, custeamos os seus estudos para a certificação e financiamos a sua prova em caso de aprovação.


BEM ESTAR


Ambiente de Trabalho: acreditamos na autonomia, por isso, nosso ambiente é flexível e apoia o desenvolvimento/crescimento de seus membros. Somos reconhecidos por isso: no Glassdoor, temos 4,7/5 de avaliação e 98% de recomendação entre quem já fez parte do nosso time.

Licenças Maternidade e Paternidade: sabemos que esse é um momento único, por isso, nossos clubistas contam com licenças estendidas.


CRESCIMENTO


Programa de Desenvolvimento de Lideranças (PDL): valorizamos o crescimento interno e a formação de líderes. Nosso PDL é voltado para colaboradores que desejam seguir uma carreira de gestão, oferecendo trilhas de aprendizado, mentorias e desenvolvimento estratégico.

Crescimento: temos um modelo de partnership que possibilita e estimula o crescimento de todos dentro da empresa, inclusive, premiando os melhores membros com a possibilidade de entrada na sociedade.


TRANQUILIDADE FINANCEIRA


Benefícios Multi Flexível: atuamos com o cartão Flash e ele permite que você tenha autonomia de utilizar o seu benefício em diversas frentes como transporte, alimentação, cultura, lazer, entre outros.


MAIS INFORMAÇÕES SOBRE O CLUBE

Youtube: Clube do Valor

title: Executivo de Vendas - PAS-X MES
description:
Körber Pharma Software, Latin America

Executivo de Vendas - PAS-X MES

Körber is the home for passionate people who innovate, collaborate and love what they do. Entrepreneurial spirit is our joint DNA. We develop future technologies and support talents to deploy their skills and reach their full potential. We combine our strong heritage with our understanding of local specifics and a global mindset to bring people together and create valuable solutions for our customers. We aim to be the first to do the right thing at the right time.


Join the home for entrepreneurs!


Your role in our team

We are looking for a Sales Executive with a result-oriented mindset to join our local Sales operations within our Latin America Hub. You will be presenting and offering our global market leader WERUM PAS-X MES/EBR solution suite. You will work close to global and local Life Sciences Industries, acting as an Account Manager for customers and as a main commercial contact for new leads and prospects. Among others, your main responsibilities include:

  • Meet with Clients to present the entire product portfolio of Körber Pharma Software and to communicate our solution value clearly and effectively to business and technical audiences.
  • Possess the business ability to influence and gain customer alignment at all levels within customer organizations.
  • Create and quantify value for our customers by mapping their requirements against the capability of our products.
  • Assume responsibility for dedicated accounts to retain and grow Körber Pharma Software’s market share with existing customers.
  • Develop and implement account strategies for your accounts, growing revenue across multiple business types.
  • Develop an in-depth understanding of the client’s business, industry trends, and market forces affecting their business and product needs. 
  • Demonstrate technical products where required to win customer confidence.
  • Maintain customer information, account mapping, key contacts, and opportunity information in our Salesforce CRM system.
  • Travel within Brazil and Latin America with occasional travel to other Körber Pharma and Customer locations as required (approx. 50% of time).


Your profile

  • Experience with regulated environments (drug production & validation) and understanding of pharmaceutical processes and expectations of regulated companies.
  • Experience and knowledge of MES systems in Life Sciences industry (Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology and similar) - Knowledge/Background of WERUM PAS-X is a plus.
  • Brazilian Portuguese native language fluency.
  • Proficiency in English and Spanish languages – professional conversational, reading and writing.
  • More than two (2) years’ experience in complex IT solutions sales. Thorough understanding of software project life cycles. Knowledge of key IT systems used in manufacturing.
  • Customer focus with superior listening skills and excellent written and verbal communication capability.
  • Energetic and enthusiastic personality.
  • Comfortable working at all levels of customer organization.
  • Action orientated and results driven.
  • Business acumen and empathy with customer needs and goals.
  • Excellent MS Office skills, especially Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.
  • A Bachelor of Science Degree in a Science or Business Administration Degree is required. Other Engineering qualifications will be considered.


Your working environment at Körber


Körber Business Area Pharma is the leading provider for MES software to the pharmaceutical and biotech manufacturing industry. Our first-in-class WERUM PAS-X software offering allows our customers to control and record the making of life saving therapies to ensure the best possible business and patient outcomes. We are seeking talented individuals as we look to transform our business and products to meet the constantly shifting demands of the ongoing revolution in factory digitization and automation.


Your benefits

  • You will work in a modern work environment with an open culture towards improvements and new ideas.
  • You are part of a global operating company with a wide customer base and a growing business.
  • You profit from international cooperation within a group-expert network to implement corporate wide concepts.
  • You will work in a team who focuses on customer requirements.
  • Opportunities for personal development enabling attractive career paths as you work in interesting, challenging and varied projects.
  • You will have flexible working hours in the office or working from home.


Can you find yourself in this profile?


Then you are right at Körber. We are looking forward to getting to know you!

Minimum of 2 years of field experience in roles such as MSL, Medical Liaison, relationship management with research centers, Sales Force.

title: Gerente de vendas
description:
About the job


1. About Us


We are a leading global technology company operating in the high-growth sector of On-Demand Consumer Services . Leveraging innovative technology and proven strategies from a global digital commerce leader, we are driving massive international expansion. We offer a challenging, fast-paced environment and an unparalleled opportunity to build and scale a business from the ground up in new markets.


2. Responsibilities


  • Team Building and Empowerment : Assist our organization in establishing a local sales team , building from scratch to drive business expansion. Rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals through systematic one-on-one and group training models.
  • System Development and Optimization : Establish and maintain smooth internal and external communication channels. Continuously optimize team operational mechanisms based on different stages of business development to strengthen the team’s professional expertise.
  • Cultural Integration and Team Building : Demonstrate the ability to manage multicultural teams effectively and build a high-performance team that aligns with the company's core values.
  • Goal Setting and Alignment : Combine senior leadership requirements with the team's actual situation, conduct comprehensive assessments and provide feedback, clarify work objectives, and set phased goals according to timelines.
  • Process Management and Tracking : Utilize a mature Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) framework to ensure smooth operations at the frontline. Adjust strategies promptly based on business progress to ensure process management meets requirements.
  • Outcome Achievement and Review : Ensure work objectives are achieved successfully. Conduct reviews of work processes, explore more efficient methods, summarize experiences, and accumulate valuable insights for future work.
  • Time Management and Optimization : Clearly define time management priorities for the role and different levels, and optimize personal time management based on actual circumstances.


3. Basic Requirements


  • Management Experience : Proven experience in managing sales teams , with outstanding performance in a high-growth company over the past years.
  • Team Leadership Methods : Ability to clearly articulate methods for leading teams to success, with proven, replicable experience in overseas markets.
  • Experience Sharing : Actively share work experiences and provide actionable improvement suggestions to help the team quickly enhance their capabilities.
  • Strategic Thinking : Possess a holistic mindset with the ability to clearly plan business and team development pathways. When facing challenges, accurately identify root causes and coordinate between global headquarters and various teams to resolve issues swiftly.
  • Focus on Talent Development : Prioritize talent growth, having previously served as a corporate trainer or established a training system within the team.
  • Motivation and Resilience : Demonstrate strong ambition and professionalism, willingness to challenge oneself, and the ability to handle work-related pressure effectively.
  • Language Proficiency : Fluent in English (speaking, listening, reading, and writing), with the ability to adapt to long-term overseas work.


4. Job Highlights


Join us to witness the rapid growth of a global digital giant's international business expansion and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

Se você é apaixonado(a) por tecnologia e quer crescer em um ambiente que valoriza autonomia, aprendizado contínuo e impacto real, a Hypesoft é o lugar certo para você. Candidate‑se e venha construir o futuro conosco!

Resumo do Cargo:

O Head de Produtos – Beleza, Saúde e Bem-Estar será responsável por liderar o desenvolvimento e o gerenciamento estratégico das linhas de produtos do portfólio (cosméticos, suplementos, produtos para cílios e outros relacionados ao bem-estar). Esse profissional será peça-chave na pesquisa de tendências, inovação de mercado, e na criação de propostas de valor que assegurem o posicionamento competitivo e o crescimento sustentável das marcas.

A posição exige visão de mercado, forte capacidade de gestão e habilidades críticas para alinhar objetivos de negócio com as necessidades dos consumidores, garantindo diferenciação e excelência nas entregas dos produtos.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Estratégia de Produto : Desenvolver e liderar o planejamento estratégico do portfólio de produtos, alinhado à visão da empresa, identificando oportunidades e maximizando o retorno financeiro.
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida do Produto : Monitorar o ciclo de vida de cada produto, garantindo constante inovação e adequação às demandas dos consumidores e tendências globais.
  • Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento (P&D) : Colaborar com equipes internas e fornecedores para criar produtos seguros, eficazes e inovadores, acompanhando regulamentações e padrões de qualidade do setor.
  • Análise de Mercado : Realizar estudos de mercado e análise competitiva para identificar tendências emergentes em beleza, saúde e bem-estar, propondo inovações que otimizem a posição da marca.
  • Lançamentos de Produtos : Coordenar todo o processo de lançamento, desde a ideia inicial até o mercado (go-to-market), incluindo precificação, embalagem, distribuição e estratégias comerciais.
  • Relacionamento com Parceiros : Gerenciar fornecedores, parceiros de fabricação e distribuidores para assegurar que os produtos atendam aos padrões da empresa e exigências regulatórias.
  • Gestão de Equipes : Supervisionar e estruturar times de marketing, P&D e produto para garantir integração e eficiência no planejamento e execução das estratégias.
  • Inovação Sustentável : Propor soluções de produtos alinhadas às práticas de ESG (ambientais, sociais e de governança), priorizando embalagens e processos produtivos sustentáveis.
  • Indicadores de Desempenho (KPIs) : Acompanhar métricas de desempenho, incluindo recepção do consumidor, vendas, participação de mercado e rentabilidade dos produtos.


Qualificações Requeridas:

  • Formação Acadêmica : Ensino superior completo em Administração, Marketing, Farmácia, Cosmética, Engenharias ou áreas correlatas. Desejável especialização ou MBA em Negócios, Gestão de Produtos ou Marketing.
  • Experiência :
  • Experiência consolidada (mínimo de 3 a 5 anos) na liderança de desenvolvimento e gestão de produtos, com foco em beleza, saúde e bem-estar.
  • Histórico comprovado em gerenciamento de portfólios complexos e multicanais (varejo, e-commerce, marketplaces).
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos :
  • Background em cosméticos (skin care, hair care, maquiagens), suplementos alimentares e/ou afins.
  • Familiaridade com regulamentações do setor, como ANVISA e padrões internacionais de qualidade.
  • Domínio de metodologias de desenvolvimento de produtos, como design thinking, roadmap e go-to-market.
  • Habilidades Analíticas :
  • Capacidade de analisar dados de mercado e indicadores financeiros, transformando insights em estratégias eficientes.


Habilidades e Competências Comportamentais:

  • Liderança Inspiradora : Habilidade para engajar equipes multidisciplinares, promovendo colaboração e inovação.
  • Adaptabilidade : Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos em ambientes dinâmicos e altamente competitivos.
  • Criatividade e Inovação : Perfil curioso e antenado às tendências globais de beleza e bem-estar, trazendo destaque para a marca.
  • Foco no Cliente : Visão centrada na experiência do cliente como base para o desenvolvimento e posicionamento de produtos.
  • Gestão de Negócios : Capacidade de alinhar visão criativa com objetivos financeiros, otimizando o desempenho do portfólio.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência no segmento premium ou em marcas de luxo.
  • Vivência prévia com sustentabilidade e inovação em beleza e saúde.
  • Fluência em inglês e/ou outros idiomas, para colaborar com fornecedores e clientes internacionais.
  • Conhecimentos em ferramentas analíticas como Power BI, Tableau, ou data-driven marketing.


Regime de Trabalho e Benefícios:

  • Regime de Contratação : CLT ou PJ, com possibilidade de participação nos lucros ou bônus por desempenho.
  • Disponibilidade : Viagens nacionais e internacionais para eventos, feiras e reuniões com fornecedores/parceiros.
  • Benefícios : Cartão de benefícios flexível, plano de saúde, bem-estar corporativo, bônus por metas e acesso a produtos da marca.

title: MECÂNICO(A) INDUSTRIAL III
description:
Somos a ERO, uma mineradora que nasceu no coração do Brasil e cresceu levando para o mundo mais força e energia — uma força que impulsiona setores produtivos e contribui para o desenvolvimento de diferentes regiões.


Desde 1979, quando iniciou suas atividades na unidade Caraíba, a empresa vem consolidando sua presença no setor mineral brasileiro, expandindo para a mina de ouro em Xavantina, avançando na implantação da unidade Tucumã — que promete se tornar um dos principais polos de produção de cobre do país. Nosso crescimento é movido pela experiência em exploração, que nos ajuda a expandir a vida útil de nossas minas e a avançar em novos projetos, como o Projeto Furnas, no Pará.


Nosso jeito de fazer mineração é guiado por valores sólidos: cuidado, coragem, honestidade, colaboração e excelência. Esses princípios estão no centro de tudo o que fazemos — desde o chão da mina até as decisões estratégicas. E eles também orientam como cuidamos do crescimento de cada pessoa na Ero.


O nosso objetivo é claro: ser a melhor empresa de mineração do Brasil, e sabemos que isso só é possível investindo nas pessoas que constroem esse futuro com a gente, todos os dias.


Se identificou?

Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar como Mecânico(a) Industrial III , que será responsável por realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva, reparos em sistemas mecânicos, hidráulicos e pneumáticos, além de montar, inspecionar e substituir componentes em equipamentos industriais.

As an L2 Security Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of EDR solutions by monitoring platform health, enforcing security policies, and troubleshooting endpoint issues across multiple EDR platforms including CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and SentinelOne. Your role includes onboarding devices, validating security rules, handling basic policy enforcement issues, and ensuring that all endpoints remain compliant with security baselines. You will assist in resolving connectivity issues, missing telemetry cases, and agent health checks while escalating complex platform-related problems to L3.


Key Responsibilities:

· Ensure endpoints are successfully onboarded to EDR solutions across all platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android).

· Monitor endpoint connectivity and health status within the EDR portals.

· Validate that security rules, EDR, and antivirus policies are applied correctly.

· Assist in troubleshooting policy conflicts and enforcement issues.

· Investigate and validate EDR alerts, classify threats, and escalate incidents if required.

· Apply basic remediation steps like isolating devices, initiating scans, or triggering automated investigations.

· Identify endpoints not reporting telemetry or experiencing EDR agent failures.

· Perform basic troubleshooting (e.g., restarting services, re-onboarding devices, checking connectivity).

· Escalate complex security incidents and persistent issues to L3.

· Assist in preparing incident summaries and compliance reports for management.

· Ensure endpoints are running the latest security patches and EDR updates.

· Validate compliance with security baselines and recommend corrective actions.

· Collaborate with global SOC, Threat Hunting, and Incident Response teams for critical security incidents.


Required Skills & Knowledge:

· Hands-on expertise in CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and SentinelOne.

· Ability to analyze malware behaviors, execute incident containment strategies, and escalate threats appropriately.

· Scripting knowledge in PowerShell or Python (preferred).

· Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills.


Work Environment & Shift Requirements:

· 24x7 support model with rotational shifts (including nights, weekends, and holidays).

· Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure SOC environment.

· Excellent collaboration and coordination with global cybersecurity teams.


Preferred Certifications:

· CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA)

· Palo Alto Networks Certified Cybersecurity Associate (PCCSA)

· Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200)

· SentinelOne Certified Administrator

Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.

Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.


AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.


Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)

  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)

  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)


Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency


Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback



Why Top Editors Choose Us:


Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.


Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.


See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

We empower top tech companies to create and refine paradigm-shifting mobile, smart home, and AI products.


If you enjoy fieldwork, are comfortable riding in vehicles with research participants, and love analyzing qualitative data, then you're a perfect fit. You'll work directly with our researchers to execute a unique qualitative research project on driver behavior. 


For this project, you will meet UX researchers and study participants designated locations in Sao Paulo and will ride in the participant's vehicle to provide technical support and general assistance to the UX researcher during the drives. You MUST be willing to do this to be considered for this role.


After the driving portion, from December 1-11, you will assist the researchers with data analysis and preparation of the final report for this project.


This is a Sao Paulo based contract position. Occasionally, you will be required to work after standard work hours, including weekends.



Key Responsibilities

  • Work closely with UX researchers for the project, and ride with the researcher in a participant's vehicle for 3-6 hours per day from December 1 to December 11.
  • After December 11, you will assist researchers with analysis and translation of data captured during the drives.
  • Assist project team members with the logistical operations of the research program, such as maintaining cameras and other equipment, uploading video files, helping schedule drives with participants.
  • Analyze responses from participant videos and transcripts, surveys, and other study data to develop key research findings and recommendations for the client
  • Under the guidance of UX researchers, help create deliverables for the client including scorecards, toplines, reports, and slide decks.


 Basic Qualifications

  • 1-5 years of experience working as technical support, customer support or a research analyst in a research setting or at a tech company.
  • Professional proficiency in English and Portuguese with strong written and verbal communications in both.
  • Ability to talk to strangers, make them feel at ease, and quickly build a rapport.
  • Experience data collection, analysis, and interpretation.
  • High attention to detail and ability to recognize patterns and anomalies in data.
  • Collaborative attitude and ability to foster a positive work environment.
  • Very comfortable using emerging technologies and different software systems. 
  • High comfort working with Google Docs, Google Sheets, or similar products.
  • A positive, curious attitude and willingness to learn.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Undergraduate degree in computer science, psychology, research methods, human computer interaction, sociology, or related field. 
  • Previous experience conducting research fieldwork for international clients.
  • Previous work with early-to-mid stage startups or top tech companies.

Our excellence has been recognized by G2 and honoured with the SME100 Award, underscoring our rapid growth and innovative solutions. Our workforce is a testament to our global reach, with remote workforce and employees from all around the world, contributing to our diverse and inclusive culture. At Respond.io, we are not just a platform—we are a movement, pushing the boundaries of customer communication for tech-savvy organizations worldwide. Join us, and be part of a team that is shaping the future of business messaging!


Role Description

At Respond.io, Sales are pivotal to our company’s success. As a sales personnel, you will be using proactive and inbound selling strategies to engage with mid to large-size businesses to close new business. You will use your knowledge of handling B2B sales to identify business opportunities with current leads and prospective key clients.


We are looking for a Account Executive to join our Sales team and focus on our Mid Market customers across LATAM. This segment represents a huge opportunity for respond.io and we want someone who is eager to do the best work of their lives while supporting others in doing the same.


You will be responsible for driving the sales process with prospective customers as well as expansion within existing accounts. You will work closely with our customers to understand their business goals and act as their trusted guide to understanding how respond.io would be a good fit in their organization. You'll also work with cross-functional teams to help align our product roadmap and marketing materials with customer feedback. If you enjoy working with customers from a variety of industries in a rapidly changing environment, then come and join us!


Responsibilities

  • Be the driving force behind our revenue growth by proactively seeking new opportunities.
  • Educate potential customers on the immense value that respond.io offers.
  • Provide tailored solution recommendations based on customers' unique business needs and usage patterns.
  • Manage multiple customer relationships simultaneously, guiding them through various stages of the sales process.
  • Handle inbound customer inquiries with finesse, effectively addressing billing, legal, security, and technical concerns.
  • Act as the advocate for our customers, collecting valuable feedback to fuel ongoing improvements, including product enhancements.
  • Stay informed about industry trends, competitive offerings, and emerging technologies to effectively position the company’s products in the market.
  • Assist with additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to contribute to the team's success.


Qualifications

  • Prior experience in B2B SaaS sales is a must.
  • Exceptional proficiency in clear and concise spoken and written English and Spanish is essential.
  • A track record of successfully closing sales deals within a B2B SaaS company is highly preferred.
  • You're passionate about identifying customer needs and ensuring their satisfaction.
  • An ambitious and goal-driven mindset is crucial for success.
  • Good communication skills in English and Spanish with an ability to clearly explain complex ideas verbally and in writing.
  • You thrive in a flexible and dynamic environment, showing resilience in the face of challenges.


Here's what's in for you

  • You will become part of an amazing culture with smart, collaborative teammates who actually care about each other's growth and success.

Effective management and leadership skills with strong verbal and written communication skills;

Proven experience in leading teams in the Shared Services Center area;

Willingness to live and work in the city of São José do Rio Preto.

title: Gerente de Marketing

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. As a Domain Consultant for SOC Transformation you will be the expert for our Cortex portfolio, a Next-Gen AI-powered security operations platform. You will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives. You evangelize our industry leading solutions in Security Intelligence and Automation, XDR, Attack Surface Management, SOAR and Incident Response that establish Palo Alto Networks as a customer’s cybersecurity partner of choice.

  • Help our customers build and develop further their services around Cortex solutions

  • Initiate projects to improve individual team’s performance

  • Act as a conduit for customer feedback to Product Management, Technical Marketing, competitor intelligence, and R&D to create requirements and deliver product features for our customers
